market.rules_primary: If the value of the Index.US30/USD is at least $52,050 at October 26, 2026 at 4pm ET, then the market resolves to Yes.
market.rules_secondary:
The market resolves based on the value of the Index.US30/USD at the exact time specified in October 26, 2026 at 4pm ET, as reported by Pyth Network, using the index's natively published level in its own currency and units; no currency conversion is applied. If the value of the Index.US30/USD at October 26, 2026 at 4pm ET is at least $52,050, the market resolves to Yes. If not, the market resolves to No. Revisions to the underlying made after expiration will not be accounted for in determining the Expiration Value.
